name: flyte-deploy-kind
description: Deploy a Flyte v2 (flyte-binary) cluster on kind — on your local machine or a cloud VM (DigitalOcean, AWS EC2, or GCP), backed by a hosted PostgreSQL (Supabase/external) and S3-compatible object store (AWS S3 or Cloudflare R2), with optional OIDC auth via Traefik + oauth2-proxy and an in-cluster Dex IdP for testing.
